news.title: Hemo Organic Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 31.171875 million in funding from Qmin Realities Private Limited, Bhavsar Enterprises Pvt Ltd, and other investor.
news.body: Hemo Organic Limited announced private placement of up to 9,975,000 convertible warrants at an issue price of INR 3.125 for gross proceeds of INR 31,171,875 on December 11, 2025. The transaction includes participation from Vishwambar Kameshwar Singh 3,300,000 warrants at a pre - issue shareholding of 0.18%,  Post-Preferential Issue shareholding of 24.60% , Vacro Enterprises Private Limited for 3,350,000 warrants at a Post-Preferential Issue shareholding of 24.92%, Qmin Realities Private Limited for 3,325,000 warrants at a Post-Preferential Issue shareholding of 24.74 %. The warrants have an exercise price of INR 9.375. The Warrant shall be convertible into equal number equity shares having face value of INR 10 within a maximum tenure of 18 months from the date of allotment of the warrants.
